title: Would Millennials replace Ryerson statue with naked Trump?
description:
The Ryerson Students' Union and the Indigenous Students' Association want Ryerson University to change its name and remove the Egerton Ryerson statue. Watch as David Menzies offers the kids on campus alternative statues of questionable taste.
